title: tea caddy
text: tea caddy. This is the perfect counter top or even cupboard tea organizer.  Easy to load, super easy to use - pulling the tea packets out.  I put the regular tea on one side and the decaf on the other. You can easily see the teas... I just like that the tea boxes are off my counter and this caddy is neat and tidy. You can put 6 different teas on each side, 12 in total. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: YouCopia TeaStand Tea Organizer, White
features: Store and organize 100+ tea bags neatly in your kitchen cabinet (tea not included)
Compact organizer removes tea box clutter and saves space; fits in standard kitchen cabinets
Includes 12 clear, removable bins for easy viewing and selection
Can be moved to stand on any flat surface - countertop or table - for display; Bins are BPA-free and top rack dishwasher safe
No assembly required; Durable plastic easy to clean with damp cloth; Measures 8-9/16" H x 10-13/16" D x 4-7/8" W
One minute set-up, no tools required
description: TeaStand is the only cabinet organizer for tea bags! Store 100 plus tea bags in the dark, dry cabinet to protect flavors and eliminate box clutter. Measuring just under 5 inches wide, the sleek, lightweight design is easy to grab and move anywhere. The TeaStand includes 12 clear, removable bins that allow a full view of tea bag labels. Place the organizer on any flat surface – a countertop or table – to pick your tea of choice. It’s great for entertaining and making your guests feel at home. Bin inner dimensions: 2-5/8"W x 2-1/8"D x 2-1/8"H
